ac_summary: AC-1 — Router-level 404/405 refusals carry the contract envelope
AC-2 — specs.md section 11 documents the edge-owned 400 and the in-app 404/405 mapping
AC-3 — Capacity-reject 422 carries details.fields naming the field
AC-4 — The conformance sweep asserts the envelope shape on all eight classes and passes
AC-5 — Backend floor green, no regressions, ruff clean

verification_commands.ac2:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-2: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f _docs/specs.md ] || { echo "FAIL AC-2: not run from the TableQueue repo root (_docs/specs.md missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-2: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p backend/.scratch
scratch="backend/.scratch/_t18ac2_$$.db"; srel="${scratch#backend/}"; rm -f "$scratch.out"
backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe - <<'PY' > "$scratch.out" 2>&1
import re, sys
text = open("_docs/specs.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
m = re.search(r"^## 11\..*?(?=^## )", text, re.S | re.M)
if not m:
    print("no section 11 (Error Codes) found in _docs/specs.md")
    sys.exit(1)
section = m.group(0)
lines = section.splitlines()
hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r"oversized|request[ -]?line", l, re.I)]
problems = []
if not hits:
    problems.append("no oversized/request-line note in section 11 (the edge-owned 400 is not documented)")
else:
    i = hits[0]
    window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, i - 30): i + 30]).lower()
    if "400" not in window:
        problems.append("the edge note does not name the 400 status")
    if not re.search(r"uvicorn|edge|h11", window):
        problems.append("the edge note does not name the edge owner (uvicorn/edge/h11)")
if "405" not in section.lower():
    problems.append("section 11 does not document the in-app 405 envelope mapping (the code table carries no 405, so only the note can)")
if problems:
    print("; ".join(problems))
    sys.exit(1)
print("static OK")
PY
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  cat "$scratch.out"
  echo "FAIL AC-2: _docs/specs.md section 11 does not document the oversized-request-line 400 as edge-owned with the in-app 404/405 contract mapping"
  rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-2: specs.md section 11 documents the edge-owned oversized-request-line 400 and the in-app 404/405 contract mapping"
rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
exit 0
verification_commands.ac3:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-3: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f backend/app/services/tables.py ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: not run from the TableQueue repo root (backend/app/services/tables.py missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p backend/.scratch
scratch="backend/.scratch/_t18ac3_$$.db"; srel="${scratch#backend/}"; rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"
( cd backend && env DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///$srel" JWT_SECRET="t18ac3-secret-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" STAFF_PIN=0000 ENV=development TZ=UTC .venv/Scripts/python.exe - <<'PY' > "${srel}.out" 2>&1
import logging, sys, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
logging.disable(logging.WARNING)

def fields_of(resp):
    try:
        b = resp.json()
    except Exception:
        return None
    err = b.get("error") if isinstance(b, dict) else None
    det = err.get("details") if isinstance(err, dict) else None
    return det.get("fields") if isinstance(det, dict) else None

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

problems = []
with TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False) as c:
    login = c.post("/api/v1/auth/login", json={"pin": "0000"})
    if login.status_code != 200:
        print("login failed: %d %r" % (login.status_code, login.text[:200]))
        sys.exit(1)
    h = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + login.json()["access_token"]}
    create = c.post("/api/v1/admin/tables", headers=h, json={"label": "T18", "capacity": 4})
    if create.status_code != 201:
        print("table create failed: %d %r" % (create.status_code, create.text[:200]))
        sys.exit(1)
    tid = create.json()["id"]
    for bad in (21, 0):
        r = c.patch("/api/v1/admin/tables/%s" % tid, headers=h, json={"capacity": bad})
        try:
            b = r.json()
        except Exception:
            b = None
        err = b.get("error") if isinstance(b, dict) else None
        if r.status_code != 422 or not isinstance(err, dict) or err.get("code") != "VALIDATION_ERROR":
            problems.append("capacity=%d: answered %d with code %r, want 422 VALIDATION_ERROR" % (bad, r.status_code, err.get("code") if isinstance(err, dict) else None))
            continue
        f = fields_of(r)
        if not isinstance(f, dict) or set(f.keys()) != {"capacity"} or not all(isinstance(v, str) and v for v in f.values()):
            problems.append("capacity=%d: details.fields is %r, want a field->message map naming 'capacity'" % (bad, f))
    r = c.post("/api/v1/admin/tables", headers=h, json={"label": "T18B", "capacity": 21})
    f = fields_of(r)
    if r.status_code != 422 or not isinstance(f, dict) or "capacity" not in f:
        problems.append("schema-level create capacity=21: answered %d with fields %r - parity broken" % (r.status_code, f))
if problems:
    for p in problems:
        print("  " + p)
    sys.exit(1)
print("PROBE_OK")
PY
)
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  cat "$scratch.out"
  echo "FAIL AC-3: the service capacity-reject 422 does not carry details.fields naming the field (schema-level parity checked too)"
  rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-3: service capacity-reject 422 (capacity=21 and 0) carries details.fields naming 'capacity'; schema-level parity holds"
rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
exit 0
verification_commands.ac4:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-4: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f _docs/openapi.yaml ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: not run from the TableQueue repo root (_docs/openapi.yaml missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
F=backend/tests/test_e2e_contract.py
[ -f "$F" ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: the conformance sweep test file backend/tests/test_e2e_contract.py is missing - if it moved, re-groom this AC"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p backend/.scratch
scratch="backend/.scratch/_t18ac4_$$.db"; srel="${scratch#backend/}"; rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"
( cd backend && env DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///$srel" JWT_SECRET="t18ac4-secret-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" STAFF_PIN=0000 ENV=development TZ=UTC .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_e2e_contract.py -q > "${srel}.out" 2>&1 )
prc=$?
backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe - "$F" <<'PY'
import sys
F = sys.argv[1]
t = open(F, encoding="utf-8").read()
problems = []
for status in ("401", "404", "405", "409", "422", "429", "500", "503"):
    if status not in t:
        problems.append("no reference to status class %s" % status)
if "error" not in t.lower():
    problems.append("no envelope assertion (the 'error' key literal is absent from the sweep)")
if problems:
    print("FAIL AC-4: the conformance sweep does not assert envelope shape on all eight classes - " + "; ".join(problems))
    sys.exit(1)
print("static OK")
PY
s=$?
if [ $s -ne 0 ]; then
  rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
if [ $prc -ne 0 ] || ! grep -q " passed" "$scratch.out"; then
  tail -n 5 "$scratch.out"
  echo "FAIL AC-4: the conformance sweep run answered rc=$prc - last lines above"
  rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-4: the conformance sweep references all eight status classes (401/404/405/409/422/429/500/503) and passes ($(tail -n 1 "$scratch.out" | grep -o '[0-9]* passed[^,]*' | head -1))"
rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch.out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
exit 0
verification_commands.ac5:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-5: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f backend/pyproject.toml ] || { echo "FAIL AC-5: not run from the TableQueue repo root (backend/pyproject.toml missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-5: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/ruff.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-5: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/ruff.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p backend/.scratch
out="backend/.scratch/_t18ac5_$$.out"; rm -f "$out" "$out.ruff"
( cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests -q -p no:randomly > ../"$out" 2>&1 )
rc=$?
summary=$(grep -E "passed|failed|error" "$out" | tail -1 | xargs)
if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || ! echo "$summary" | grep -qE "^[0-9]+ passed, 2 xfailed(, [0-9]+ warnings)? in "; then
  tail -n 20 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-5: backend suite not green or the xfail set moved (rc=$rc; summary: $summary) - last lines above"
  rm -f "$out" "$out.ruff"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
passed_count=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE "^[0-9]+ passed" | grep -oE "[0-9]+" | head -1)
if [ "$passed_count" -lt 335 ]; then
  echo "FAIL AC-5: the passed floor shrank (summary: $summary) - the groom baseline was 335 passed"
  rm -f "$out" "$out.ruff"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
( cd backend && .venv/Scripts/ruff.exe check . > "../$out.ruff" 2>&1 )
lrc=$?
if [ $lrc -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -n 20 "$out.ruff"
  echo "FAIL AC-5: ruff check . not clean (rc=$lrc) - last lines above"
  rm -f "$out" "$out.ruff"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-5: $summary + ruff clean - backend floor holds (groom baseline 335 passed, 2 xfailed)"
rm -f "$out" "$out.ruff"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
exit 0
